# lumen-core/src/constants.rs

Names in one place.

- `APP_NAME` "Lumen", `APP_ID` `io.github.lumenlauncher.Lumen` (also D-Bus name/iface), `DBUS_PATH`.
- `VERSION`, `REPO_URL`, `DEFAULT_SHORTCUT` `<Alt>space`.
- `SEARCH_ENGINES` — id, name, URL template.
- `WEB_KEYWORDS` — `g`, `ddg`, `yt`, `gh`, `wiki`, `maps`, `npm`, `so`, `tr`, `img`, `reddit`, `mdn`.
